==Biography==
His name is Benjamín Ignacio Fuenzalida Barrera, was born and lives in Santiago, Chile.

=== 2015 Season===
His debut was in [[Soul Gamer]] as AD carry participating in minor tournaments, in July of that year he leaves the team. 

=== 2016 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Game Over]] as AD Carry participating in minor tournaments, in April of that year he leaves the team.

In the middle of the year he joins [[Dark Horse]] as AD Carry participating in the [[CDLS 2016 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CDLS 2016 Closing Playoffs]] the team faced [[Bencheados]] losing 0-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2017 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Isurus]] as AD Carry participating in the [[CLS 2017 Opening]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Opening Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[Furious Gaming]] winning 3-0, being champion for the first time, qualifying for the first time to an international tournament. Already in the MSI the team was in group B facing [[GIGABYTE Marines]], [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]] and [[Virtus.pro]], where the team was last in the group stage. At mid-year [[Kindless]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]]  the team reached the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 1-3.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Kindless]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] 0-3. At mid-year [[Kindless]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] the team was fourth in the tournament losing against [[Rebirth eSports]] 0-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[XTEN Esports]] as AD Carry participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was sixth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] the team was sixth in the tournament losing against [[Rainbow7]] 1-3, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team. At mid-year he joins [[Pixel Esports Club|Pixel Esports]] as AD Carry participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was last in the tournament, having to play the relegation. Already in [[LLA 2020 Opening Promotion]] the team faces [[MAD Lions E.C. Colombia|MAD Lions Colombia]] earning 3-1, saving his place.
